notes: Hybrid real-time WebGPU/RTX sample, not a full path tracer: rasterized primary visibility is augmented by deterministic native ray-query lighting and reflections.

Fourteen clearcoat/transmissive jelly meshes share a packed dynamic triangle stream whose RTX BLAS is refitted from the live soft-body transforms without placing duplicate frozen jellies in the static scene.
The enclosed reflective DJ warehouse, epoxy floor, booth, decks, massive gummy humanoid DJ, speakers, trusses, LED wall and practical emitters form the authored club environment.
Deterministic fixed-step physics supplies gravity, arena and jelly-to-jelly collisions, volume-preserving squash and stretch, damped wobble, beat impulses, drop impulses and pointer shockwaves.

An original in-repo generator authors a seamless-gated 45-second, 128 BPM, 48 kHz stereo PCM16 rave/house track with 96 embedded beat cues; the autoplay-safe controller exposes authored bass, pulse, energy, drop and strobe analysis to lighting and motion.
Left-drag orbits, the wheel zooms, right-click launches a shockwave, Space triggers a drop impulse, M toggles music, X compares RTX and raster, C cycles the palette and R resets the simulation.
The responsive DOM status overlay reports the live musical section, audio state, presented render path and refitted jelly triangle count.
The demo requires no sample-specific C++ or Runtime-native shader changes and uses no downloaded models, textures or music.
